posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina wished Rohit Shetty on his birthday amid rift rumors, while fans continue to buzz about her family life with Vicky Kaushal and their newborn son.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit's 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' is set to join Imtiaz Ali's top 5 openings, while fans relive his electrifying Jimmy Fallon debut and Bhangra performances from his sold-out tour.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia's Cannes 2026 red carpet look set the internet ablaze despite trolls, and she's now confirmed for Tumbbad 3. She returned to Mumbai with Ranbir Kapoor sporting her iconic 'TIRED' t-shirt.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka is filming SS Rajamouli's mega-budget 'Varanasi' in Hyderabad alongside Mahesh Babu, and has also been roped in for Hrithik Roshan's 'Krrish 4' — a massive Bollywood comeback year.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK is filming 'King' with daughter Suhana Khan in a ₹350 crore action epic directed by Siddharth Anand, set for a Christmas 2026 release. The father-daughter duo also stars alongside Deepika Padukone.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena celebrated son Taimur's Taekwondo achievement with a proud mom moment, while her pool party photos with Saif went viral across social media.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha hit 70 million Instagram followers and treated herself to a brand new Lamborghini, while her upcoming film 'Eetha' paused production after she sustained a fracture on set.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika is juggling two mega-budget films — Atlee's 'Raaka' with Allu Arjun and SRK's 'King' — using a body double for action sequences. Palak Tiwari calls her the 'quintessential heroine.'

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Farhan Akhtar filed a formal complaint over Ranveer's departure from Don 3, with a ₹40 crore dispute ongoing. Meanwhile, 'Dhurandhar' continues its box office dominance and Rakul Preet Singh calls herself a 'huge Ranveer fan.'

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya reigned supreme at Cannes 2026 with three showstopping looks — royal blue, blush pink, and a dramatic white feathered pantsuit — marking her 24th year at the festival with daughter Aaradhya by her side.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika deleted a leaked song from 'Cocktail 2' sparking fan speculation, while her period action drama 'Rana Baali' with Vijay Deverakonda locks a September 2026 release date.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha is producing and starring in Telugu film 'Maa Inti Bangaram' alongside Gulshan Devaiah, marking a strong creative comeback after her myositis battle.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's collaboration with director Basil Joseph is confirmed (not Shaktimaan), and he met RCB star Venkatesh Iyer after an IPL 2026 match, gifting a bouquet while his son received a signed jersey.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's 'Peddi' hits ₹393K in North American pre-sales ahead of its June 4 release, while AR Rahman's massive Bhopal concert launched the 'Hellallallo' track. He also apologized for hilariously calling Bumrah a 'footballer.'

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's 'Dragon' teaser smashed records with 64 million views in 24 hours. He shed 15 kg in four months for his assassin role under director Prashanth Neel's intense vision.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi stars alongside Ram Charan in 'Peddi,' set for a June 4 release. The 'Hellallallo' song promo featuring her with Shruti Haasan dropped ahead of AR Rahman's Bhopal concert.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya's romantic drama 'Chand Mera Dil' with Lakshya opened at ₹3.31 crore and saw a 21% Day 2 jump, with a BOGO ticket push targeting Gen-Z audiences this weekend.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara shut down toxic rumors about requesting cuts in her film 'Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups,' calling the claims 'absolute nonsense.' She also shared an adorable photo of her baby girl with Sidharth Malhotra.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik's 'Krrish 4' directorial debut faces delays over a VFX disagreement with YRF — whether to go Hollywood or in-house. Priyanka Chopra is confirmed to return as Priya in the superhero saga.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun is in talks for a Hollywood debut with Mortal Kombat producer Lawrence Kasanoff for a parallel-universe action epic. Father David Dhawan got emotional at the 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' trailer launch, calling Varun every parent's dream son.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya's 'Unstoppable Tour' continues with upcoming shows in Boston this September. She also lent her voice to the patriotic track 'Matrubhoomi' for Salman Khan's 'Battle of Galwan.'

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman delivered a massive live concert in Bhopal for Ram Charan's 'Peddi' song launch, mesmerizing thousands at BHEL Dussehra Ground. He's also collaborating with Hans Zimmer on the ₹4,000 crore 'Ramayana.'

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Thalapathy Vijay's final film 'Jana Nayagan' is still awaiting CBFC certification, with the producer optimistic about a release announcement soon. The political actioner marks Vijay's farewell before his full-time political career.
